title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding is a process of converting categorical variables into a form that could be provided to ML algorithms to do a better job in prediction. Each category is converted into a new binary column.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding more features to a model can increase its complexity. Consider how this affects bias and variance.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Adding more features can reduce bias but increase variance. Think about how this tradeoff affects the model's performance.

title: Analyzing the Impact of One-Hot Encoding
text: If Sam adds one-hot encoded features for weather, will the model's bias squared increase? Consider the bias-variance tradeoff.
